==Description==
This template is designed to help users properly cite [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] dating for episodes of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series]]. '''NOTE: The template has been updated with comprehensive sourcing for all episodes, and as a result, now supports ''all'' episode numbers.'''

==Usage==
Use the following code, making sure that it is properly formatted as a [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|reference note]]. "''EPISODE NUMBER''" should be a three-digit number, the first digit being the season number and the other two digits being the individual episode number, e.g. 105 for "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]" (Season 1, Episode 5).
 <nowiki><ref>{{</nowiki>TCWdates|''EPISODE NUMBER''}}</ref>
